spans.text: ...The intel from the front would suggest that Lord Hesperus is singlehandedly defending zone A.

units.displayText: Lord Hesperus' wounds are intense, though. Any other Greater Sanctifier would have fallen long ago... but Lord Hesperus continues the fight still.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus' wounds are intense, though. Any other Greater Sanctifier would have fallen long ago... but Lord Hesperus continues the fight still.

units.rawText: I see... if that is so, we must fight till the very end as well.

units.displayText: For Magrasea!

spans.text: For Magrasea!

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifiers raise the weapons in their hands high, the candlelight that was given to them just a moment ago flickering in the wind, in and out.

spans.text: The light's master cuts and cleaves, his fiercely burning flames choking out the Entropic offense once more.

units.rawText: But there didn't seem to be any end to the monsters. Before he has any chance to rest, the mountain of Entropics gather from all directions, seeking to extinguish the meager flame.

units.displayText: Huff...

units.displayText: He can only continue to wield his blade... Just as he has always done.

spans.text: He can only continue to wield his blade... Just as he has always done.

units.rawText: ...Lord Hesperus... what do you think a Sanctifier is?
units.displayText: ...Lord Hesperus... what do you think a Sanctifier is?

spans.text: ...Lord Hesperus... what do you think a Sanctifier is?

units.rawText: You would be better off asking Eosphorus this question. His answer to that question would unravel the uncertainties in your mind far better than mine.
units.displayText: You would be better off asking Eosphorus this question. His answer to that question would unravel the uncertainties in your mind far better than mine.

spans.text: You would be better off asking Eosphorus this question. His answer to that question would unravel the uncertainties in your mind far better than mine.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: Hesperus detects the hesitation in Angelus' voice. He stands in silence for a moment, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.
units.displayText: Hesperus detects the hesitation in Angelus' voice. He stands in silence for a moment, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.

spans.text: Hesperus detects the hesitation in Angelus' voice. He stands in silence for a moment, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.

units.rawText: I cannot give you a clear answer to your question and I know not how to advise you on the matter.
units.displayText: I cannot give you a clear answer to your question and I know not how to advise you on the matter.

spans.text: I cannot give you a clear answer to your question and I know not how to advise you on the matter.

units.rawText: The duty and responsibility that Eosphorus speaks of are certainly important to Sanctifiers, but the reason that I became a Sanctifier is much more simple.
units.displayText: The duty and responsibility that Eosphorus speaks of are certainly important to Sanctifiers, but the reason that I became a Sanctifier is much more simple.

spans.text: The duty and responsibility that Eosphorus speaks of are certainly important to Sanctifiers, but the reason that I became a Sanctifier is much more simple.

units.rawText: Bestowed with sentiment, the flowers are radiant in their purity, silently guarding the names behind it.
units.displayText: Bestowed with sentiment, the flowers are radiant in their purity, silently guarding the names behind it.

spans.text: Bestowed with sentiment, the flowers are radiant in their purity, silently guarding the names behind it.

units.rawText: Battle is the only way I know to protect everyone.
units.displayText: Battle is the only way I know to protect everyone.

spans.text: Battle is the only way I know to protect everyone.

units.rawText: Before Entropy takes me, I shall keep this flame burning hot and dangerous.
units.displayText: Before Entropy takes me, I shall keep this flame burning hot and dangerous.

spans.text: Before Entropy takes me, I shall keep this flame burning hot and dangerous.

units.rawText: I don't know whether you understand the emotion known as fear...
units.displayText: I don't know whether you understand the emotion known as fear...

spans.text: I don't know whether you understand the emotion known as fear...

units.rawText: The flames surging skyward burn away the Entropics in the vicinity, igniting the gloomy battlefield once more.
units.displayText: The flames surging skyward burn away the Entropics in the vicinity, igniting the gloomy battlefield once more.

spans.text: The flames surging skyward burn away the Entropics in the vicinity, igniting the gloomy battlefield once more.

units.rawText: ...It's time for scheduled communication. Situation report, Antonina.
units.displayText: ...It's time for scheduled communication. Situation report, Antonina.

spans.text: ...It's time for scheduled communication. Situation report, Antonina.

units.displayText: Approximately one-third of the Sacred Canon is completely infected and there's nothing I can do about it.

units.displayText: ...I understand. You've done all you can.

spans.text: ...I understand. You've done all you can.

units.rawText: We determined our protocols before the operation began. No matter what happens, we cannot let the frontline impact your operation.

units.rawText: I will do everything I can to help you. This is my duty and what I must make amends for.

spans.text: I will do everything I can to help you. This is my duty and what I must make amends for.

units.rawText: ...Yes, I have not forgotten.
units.displayText: ...Yes, I have not forgotten.

spans.text: ...Yes, I have not forgotten.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader lets go of his strained expression and a rare moment of gentleness appears on his face.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader lets go of his strained expression and a rare moment of gentleness appears on his face.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader lets go of his strained expression and a rare moment of gentleness appears on his face.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, until now I didn't think this battle concerned you.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, until now I didn't think this battle concerned you.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, until now I didn't think this battle concerned you.

units.rawText: If it was not for my dereliction of duty, this conflict and this fight could all have been avoided.
units.displayText: If it was not for my dereliction of duty, this conflict and this fight could all have been avoided.

spans.text: If it was not for my dereliction of duty, this conflict and this fight could all have been avoided.

units.rawText: As his friend, I didn't correct Eosphorus appropriately when he betrayed the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: As his friend, I didn't correct Eosphorus appropriately when he betrayed the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: As his friend, I didn't correct Eosphorus appropriately when he betrayed the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: As a leader, I did not make clear to my followers the direction which we should proceed in.
units.displayText: As a leader, I did not make clear to my followers the direction which we should proceed in.

units.rawText: Hesperus...
units.displayText: Hesperus...

spans.text: Hesperus...

units.rawText: I am not as deft of mind as you are and couldn't understand the goals behind Eosphorus' words and actions.
units.displayText: I am not as deft of mind as you are and couldn't understand the goals behind Eosphorus' words and actions.

spans.text: I am not as deft of mind as you are and couldn't understand the goals behind Eosphorus' words and actions.

units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader leans downwards, touching the earth beneath him that once embodied peace and order.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader leans downwards, touching the earth beneath him that once embodied peace and order.

units.displayText: The king that once belonged here rests high in the sky, watching the slaughter below him upon the battlefield.

spans.text: The king that once belonged here rests high in the sky, watching the slaughter below him upon the battlefield.

units.rawText: But for me, all that he does is evil. No matter what his reasons are, these deeds cannot be forgotten.
units.displayText: But for me, all that he does is evil. No matter what his reasons are, these deeds cannot be forgotten.

spans.text: But for me, all that he does is evil. No matter what his reasons are, these deeds cannot be forgotten.

units.rawText: Yeah, you're right.
units.displayText: Yeah, you're right.

spans.text: Yeah, you're right.

units.rawText: For Magrasea's future existence, battle is the only option we have left.
units.displayText: For Magrasea's future existence, battle is the only option we have left.

spans.text: For Magrasea's future existence, battle is the only option we have left.

units.rawText: I must apologize for what I did before, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I must apologize for what I did before, {교수}.

spans.text: I must apologize for what I did before,

units.rawText: This final spark of hope that cannot be discovered by Eosphorus, I need your help with as well.
units.displayText: This final spark of hope that cannot be discovered by Eosphorus, I need your help with as well.

spans.text: This final spark of hope that cannot be discovered by Eosphorus, I need your help with as well.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Hesperus finally smiles, having received the other party's promise.
units.displayText: Hesperus finally smiles, having received the other party's promise.

spans.text: Hesperus finally smiles, having received the other party's promise.

units.rawText: <color=orange>I will leave you to witness the dawn of victory.</color>
units.displayText: I will leave you to witness the dawn of victory.

spans.text: I will leave you to witness the dawn of victory.

units.rawText: Another encrypted communications segment is injected into their conversation. Hesperus takes the chance to wipe away the Professor's tracks, preventing the enemy from detecting their traces.
units.displayText: Another encrypted communications segment is injected into their conversation. Hesperus takes the chance to wipe away the Professor's tracks, preventing the enemy from detecting their traces.

spans.text: Another encrypted communications segment is injected into their conversation. Hesperus takes the chance to wipe away the Professor's tracks, preventing the enemy from detecting their traces.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus, the battle hardly goes in our favor. Despite our best efforts, the Reverse Babylon Tower is all but lost.
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus, the battle hardly goes in our favor. Despite our best efforts, the Reverse Babylon Tower is all but lost.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus, the battle hardly goes in our favor. Despite our best efforts, the Reverse Babylon Tower is all but lost.

units.rawText: If we are to expect the worst, we should preserve what remaining personnel we have from the Twilight Acropolis.
units.displayText: If we are to expect the worst, we should preserve what remaining personnel we have from the Twilight Acropolis.

spans.text: If we are to expect the worst, we should preserve what remaining personnel we have from the Twilight Acropolis.

units.rawText: ...Antonina is still doing what she can. We must buy her time.
units.displayText: ...Antonina is still doing what she can. We must buy her time.

spans.text: ...Antonina is still doing what she can. We must buy her time.

units.rawText: What of the casualties?
units.displayText: What of the casualties?

spans.text: What of the casualties?

units.rawText: Those who can still fight continue to do so, but some are lost to reason due to the Canon's deterioration and cannot be transferred from the battlefield.
units.displayText: Those who can still fight continue to do so, but some are lost to reason due to the Canon's deterioration and cannot be transferred from the battlefield.

spans.text: Those who can still fight continue to do so, but some are lost to reason due to the Canon's deterioration and cannot be transferred from the battlefield.

units.rawText: ...We did not have time to give them a proper death.
units.displayText: ...We did not have time to give them a proper death.

spans.text: ...We did not have time to give them a proper death.

units.rawText: I see. Allow me to bear this responsibility.
units.displayText: I see. Allow me to bear this responsibility.

spans.text: I see. Allow me to bear this responsibility.

units.rawText: Hesperus gazes at the ruins not far away. Only a few weeks ago, it still looked like the original, peaceful Acropolis.
units.displayText: Hesperus gazes at the ruins not far away. Only a few weeks ago, it still looked like the original, peaceful Acropolis.

spans.text: Hesperus gazes at the ruins not far away. Only a few weeks ago, it still looked like the original, peaceful Acropolis.

units.rawText: Raven, did you forget the oath you swore on the square that day?
units.displayText: Raven, did you forget the oath you swore on the square that day?

spans.text: Raven, did you forget the oath you swore on the square that day?

units.rawText: ...I have not. It has been ever close to my heart.
units.displayText: ...I have not. It has been ever close to my heart.

spans.text: ...I have not. It has been ever close to my heart.

units.rawText: He has forgotten. The man who led you in swearing them has forgotten.
units.displayText: He has forgotten. The man who led you in swearing them has forgotten.

spans.text: He has forgotten. The man who led you in swearing them has forgotten.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader rises to his full height, sheathing his blade.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader rises to his full height, sheathing his blade.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader rises to his full height, sheathing his blade.

units.rawText: We have our backs to the wall. If we lose this place, we will have no place to call home.
units.displayText: We have our backs to the wall. If we lose this place, we will have no place to call home.

spans.text: We have our backs to the wall. If we lose this place, we will have no place to call home.

units.displayText: Raven, gather the remaining Sanctifiers. Have them wait behind my flames.

spans.text: Raven, gather the remaining Sanctifiers. Have them wait behind my flames.

units.rawText: Yes!
units.displayText: Yes!

spans.text: Yes!

units.displayText: Raven hastily ends the call. The Sanctifier leader moves forward, a hand on his wounds.

spans.text: Raven hastily ends the call. The Sanctifier leader moves forward, a hand on his wounds.

units.displayText: Blood paints the muddy path he walks, igniting sparks with each and every drop.

spans.text: Blood paints the muddy path he walks, igniting sparks with each and every drop.

units.rawText: ...Not much time left, I see.
units.displayText: ...Not much time left, I see.

spans.text: ...Not much time left, I see.

units.rawText: He places his weapon in a reverse grip, reciting the oath.
units.displayText: He places his weapon in a reverse grip, reciting the oath.

spans.text: He places his weapon in a reverse grip, reciting the oath.

units.rawText: <color=orange>We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.</color>
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: <color=orange>We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.</color>
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: <color=orange>For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.</color>
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.displayText: Holy flames divide the battlefield behind him, intercepting the wave of attacking Entropics.

spans.text: Holy flames divide the battlefield behind him, intercepting the wave of attacking Entropics.

spans.text: Out of either anger or instinct, the Entropics pounce upon the only enemy remaining on the battlefield.

units.displayText: The flames' master swings his blade once more, sending them to a fiery end.

spans.text: The flames' master swings his blade once more, sending them to a fiery end.

units.displayText: But when the flames fade, the Sanctifiers realize the price behind the power on display.

units.displayText: Limiter removal... Lord Hesperus is burning himself away...

units.rawText: We'll be right there, Lord Hesperus!
units.displayText: We'll be right there, Lord Hesperus!

units.displayText: Get back!

spans.text: Get back!

units.displayText: Now retreat and preserve your energy for the next battle.

units.displayText: But!

spans.text: But!

units.rawText: <size=40>No buts!</size>
units.displayText: No buts!

spans.text: No buts!

units.rawText: <size=40>You would say that the Sanctifiers have failed and that any further struggle is meaningless?</size>
units.displayText: You would say that the Sanctifiers have failed and that any further struggle is meaningless?

spans.text: You would say that the Sanctifiers have failed and that any further struggle is meaningless?

units.rawText: <size=40>You would have battered comrades retire in shame and throw away their noble sacrifice?</size>
units.displayText: You would have battered comrades retire in shame and throw away their noble sacrifice?

spans.text: You would have battered comrades retire in shame and throw away their noble sacrifice?

units.rawText: <size=40>You would tell the Agents behind you, those who you protect, that this world is beyond help and already lost to the clutches of darkness?</size>
units.displayText: You would tell the Agents behind you, those who you protect, that this world is beyond help and already lost to the clutches of darkness?

spans.text: You would tell the Agents behind you, those who you protect, that this world is beyond help and already lost to the clutches of darkness?
No.
No.
I would not.
I would not.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Good. That is the look in your eyes I want to see.</color>
units.displayText: Good. That is the look in your eyes I want to see.

spans.text: Good. That is the look in your eyes I want to see.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Before you depart, allow me to light the path forward.</color>
units.displayText: Before you depart, allow me to light the path forward.

spans.text: Before you depart, allow me to light the path forward.

units.rawText: Without further farewells, the wall forged from flames well and truly separates Hesperus from the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Without further farewells, the wall forged from flames well and truly separates Hesperus from the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Without further farewells, the wall forged from flames well and truly separates Hesperus from the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Their leader's silhouette fades from the Sanctifiers' sight, leaving only the sound of combusting operands and the screeching of Entropics.
units.displayText: Their leader's silhouette fades from the Sanctifiers' sight, leaving only the sound of combusting operands and the screeching of Entropics.

spans.text: Their leader's silhouette fades from the Sanctifiers' sight, leaving only the sound of combusting operands and the screeching of Entropics.
